# International Exhibition

# **San Diego Watercolor Society International Exhibition**

Thank you for considering entering the San Diego Watercolor Society’s 46th International Exhibition.

SDWS was established in 1965 and is one of the largest and most active in the United States. The International Exhibition is widely recognized for its high standard of excellence in water media art.

For over four decades, the International Exhibition has been an annual highlight for SDWS. The event attracts entries from hundreds of water media artists worldwide.

The Exhibition features over $25,000+ in cash and awards.

The International Show is the best-selling show of the year\! 

[**Learn about our Signature & Master Artist Membership Policy**](https://web.archive.org/web/20260120023938/https://sdws.org/userfiles/file/Policies/SDWS%20Policy%2024_5%20Signature%20Member%20and%20Master%20Artists%20rev%207_30_24.pdf) **\- accepted I-Show artists accrue eligibility** (3 \- Signature, 10 \- Master Artist)

* [46th International Exhibition OJS CFE Instructions](https://drive.google.com/file/d/12ZrARBIYs7S9F-aX5OxJzjDvR-rHALf0/view?usp=sharing)  
* [2026 SDWS 46th International Exhibition Prospectus](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1b7E1MmwQfa9dy2fEcnZxhUICVe2yb-nT/view?usp=drive_link)

 

**2026 Prospectus**

**It is crucial to read the entire Prospectus prior to entering. *The International Exhibition Standards Committee reviews all accepted paintings for compliance. Failed paintings lead to disqualification, without refund.***

All eligibility requirements including the allowed media, substrates, dates, and other important information are described in the Prospectus.

San Diego Watercolor Society Members should take note that these requirements are different from a monthly member show.

[**Click HERE for the 2026 46th International Exhibition Prospectus**](https://web.archive.org/web/20260120023938/https://sdws.org/userfiles/file/I-Show/2026%20I-Show%20Prospectus%201-10-26.pdf)

 ![][image2]**Juror Ana Laura Salazar**

Master Artist, Ana Laura Salazar comes from a family of artists, inheriting her talent from her mother, Martha Orozco. Her artistic training, complemented by various workshops, prepared her to excel in the field of painting, particularly in the watercolor technique. She has been a member of the Mexican Society of Watercolorists since 1987\. Throughout her career, she has showcased her work in numerous solo and group exhibitions in Mexico, Bulgaria, India, China and the US. Her paintings have earned national and international awards. Notably, receiving the Premio Tlacuilo multiple times at the National Watercolor Salon, organized by the National Watercolor Museum in Mexico City, as well as the Premio Tláloc, awarded by the Watercolor Museum of the State of Mexico.

Internationally, she has achieved significant recognition, including serving as a juror of the III International Youth Watercolor Festival held in Plovdiv, Bulgaria in 2025, being invited as a judge for the 2nd Kipus Bolivia Exhibition in 2024, being invited to 1st Qingdao International Watercolor Festival held in China in 2023, and winning first place in the San Diego Watercolor Society (SDWS) International Exhibition for two consecutive years 2018 & 2019\. 

Ana Laura’s artistic journey reflects a passion for watercolor and a commitment to promoting this technique through her acclaimed paintings and workshops.  She is currently fully dedicated to the visual arts, teaching painting techniques in her private studio and is excited to serve as the 2026 SDWS 46th International Exhibition Juror.

# Workshops

### **Workshop Information**

Please contact our workshops registrar at [registrar@sdws.org](https://web.archive.org/web/20260120034229/mailto:registrar@sdws.org) if you need assistance or the Workshop Director, Stephanie Van de Wetering, at [workshops@sdws.org](https://web.archive.org/web/20260120034229/mailto:workshops@sdws.org) with any questions.

**In-Gallery Workshops:** All in-gallery workshops are held in our beautifully light-filled education center inside the San Diego Watercolor Gallery in The ARTS District of Liberty Station at 2825 Dewey Rd, San Diego, CA. ([Location](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zC7buAbLieHkPXR4A))

**ZOOM Workshops:** Virtual workshops will be conducted using Zoom. They will include a combination of live painting demo(s), interactive communication with the instructor, and individual painting time \- all from the convenience of your home studio. Students will be able to download the recordings of the workshop and keep them forever.

**Upcoming Workshops**

**In person at the gallery workshops**  
\[image\] **Capturing the Moment in Watercolor**, Geoff Allen (June 8-10), $300 member/$325 non-member  
Keep it lively and spontaneous. Through coastal, landscape, and still-life subjects, you’ll learn techniques for painting with energy and freshness — indoors and outdoors.

\[image\] **Figures Through the Light and Shadow,** Eudes Correia (June 21-23), $550 member, $575 non-member  
Discover how light and shadow can transform your figure paintings. Join Eudes Correia for an inspiring deep dive into expressive, luminous figures that radiate joy and life.

\[image\] **Reality and Imagination**, Ana Laura Salazar (August 10-13), $425 member/$450 non-member  
Blend reality with imagination. Learn Ana Laura Salazar’s unique techniques for developing fantastical concepts, whimsical compositions, and magical animal-and-figure subjects.

\[image\] **Line and Watercolor**, Lori Mitchell (September 5-6), $165 member/$185 non-member  
Combine the strength of line with the beauty of watercolor. Experiment with different materials, limited palettes, and creative compositions to make your paintings pop.

**Zoom workshops**

\[image\] **Wild Birds in the Spirit of Abstract Realism**, , Zoe Evamy (July 18-20), $300 member/$325 non-member  
Bring birds to life with a twist in this acrylic workshop.. Paint realistic feathered forms while exploring abstract backgrounds for contrast and impact — all from the comfort of your own studio via Zoom

\[image\] **Florals and Fruit: From Real to Really Amazing**, Suzanne Hetzel (November 9-11), $275 member/$300 non-member  
Take your florals and still lifes from traditional to extraordinary. Each day, you’ll explore a new technique — from realistic to expressive to abstract — and leave with fresh approaches for vibrant, eye-catching paintings.

# DONATE

**DONATE**

### **THANK YOU for considering a donation to the San Diego Watercolor Society.**

A gift from you can help SDWS enrich lives through experiencing watermedia painting.

* The free SDWS Gallery offers monthly Member Exhibits, Special Exhibits and the Annual International Exhibition, which attracts hundreds of exceptional artists from all over the world.  
* Painting classes are available for elementary school children and adult painters at all skill levels.  
* Each week, community residents and SDWS members experience plein air painting at beautiful sites throughout San Diego County.
